description: The SKULLXBONES® PEE WEE brings full SKULLXBONES® style to the next generation of riders. Built on the SKULLXBONES® custom frame and rolling on 20" aluminum wheels with black stainless spokes and slick ride cruiser tires, this single-speed coaster brake cruiser is sized perfectly for young riders hitting the streets and paths of Huntington Beach. Comes complete with a deluxe built-in kickstand, adjustable seat clamp, and a cruiser seat for all-day comfort.Customize their ride with our bike accessories, or go further with our Electric Beach Cruisers.HBBC… Style.
